name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards maximum residue levels for azoxystrobin, etofenprox, fenpropidin, flupyradifurone, hexythiazox, imazalil, spinosad and tebufenozide in or on certain products
part_text:
The European Parliament is against a European Commission plan to allow slightly more of a pesticide called flupyradifurone on rapeseeds, raising the limit from 0.3 to 0.4 milligrams per kilogram. The Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and not raise any limits for this pesticide until a full safety review is finished. It says the pesticide harms wild bees and other pollinators, has not been properly tested on them, and belongs to the same chemical family as substances already banned for bee harm.

- The Parliament rejects the higher residue limit for flupyradifurone in rapeseeds; nothing changes yet.
- It affects farmers, food safety regulators, the pesticide's maker and bee populations.
- Next, the Commission must decide whether to withdraw or keep its plan.
